PURPOSE
Organize supported actions into 30, 60, and 90 day roadmap steps.

OWNER
GRETEL TRACK B

INPUT CONTRACT
actions, KPIs, validation questions, hypotheses, and diagnosis records

OUTPUT CONTRACT
roadmap_action.schema.json[]

STATUS
Skeleton only. Inactive by default. No credentials. Configure TODO nodes after import.

ROADMAP RULE
Validated or sufficiently supported actions may become implementation steps. Unvalidated hypotheses should become validation/discovery actions instead.
